description: This Java interface defines a service for managing device credentials in the Eclipse Hono framework, including methods for setting and retrieving credentials.

classes.name: CredentialsManagementService
classes.description: An interface for managing device credentials, providing methods to update/create credentials and retrieve all credentials for a device.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Updates or creates the set of credentials for a specific device, given tenant ID, device ID, optional resource version, credentials list, and tracing span. Invokes the result handler with the operation outcome.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials registered for a particular device, given tenant ID, device ID, and tracing span. Invokes the result handler with the credentials or an error status.
